1.1.2 Question 2

library(doParallel)

Loading required package: iterators


Loading required package: parallel

library(MASS)

x <- galaxies
n <- length(x)
B <- 200000

# Serial Bootstrap
t_serial <- system.time({
  med_serial <- replicate(B, median(sample(x, n, replace = TRUE)))
})["elapsed"]

t_serial

elapsed 
   2.56 

# One Bootstrap per task (in parallel)

cl <- makeCluster(detectCores() - 1) # do not want my computer to crash
registerDoParallel(cl)

t_par_single <- system.time({
  med_par_single <- foreach(i = 1:B, .combine = c) %dopar% {
    median(sample(x, n, replace = TRUE))
  }
})["elapsed"]

stopCluster(cl)
t_par_single #MUCH SLOWER

elapsed 
 14.269 

# 1000 Bootstraps per task
chunk_size <- 1000
nchunks <- 200

cl <- makeCluster(detectCores() - 1)
registerDoParallel(cl)

t_par_chunk <- system.time({
  med_par_chunk <- foreach(k = 1:nchunks, .combine = c) %dopar% {
    m <- if (k < nchunks) chunk_size else (B - (nchunks - 1) * chunk_size)
    replicate(m, median(sample(x, n, replace = TRUE)))
  }
})["elapsed"]

stopCluster(cl)

t_par_chunk # MUUUUCH FASTER

elapsed 
  0.476 




1.1.3 Question 3

n <- 50 # sample size
mu_true <- 1 # true mean of Exp(1)
B <- 2000 # number of bootstrap samples
M <- 10000 # number of Monte Carlo simulations

cl3 <- makeCluster(detectCores() - 1) # again, do not crash
registerDoParallel(cl) # register cluster for parallel foreach

coverage_vec <- foreach(m = 1:M, .combine = c) %dopar% {

  x <- rexp(n, rate = 1)

  boot_means <- replicate(B, mean(sample(x, n, replace = TRUE)))

  ci <- quantile(boot_means, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE) # percentile bootstrap confidence interval

  (ci[1] <= mu_true) && (mu_true <= ci[2]) # check whether the true mean lies inside the CI
}

stopCluster(cl3)

mean(coverage_vec) # estimated coverage probability

[1] 0.935

1.1.5 Question 5

library(parallel)

R <- 50000
set.seed(1234)

# normal way
# Generate 3 samples of size 5 from N(0,1),
# take the maximum of each sample
t_rep <- system.time(replicate
                     (R, replicate
                       (3, max(rnorm(5)))))["elapsed"]

# with for each
# get the maximum of 3 samples
set.seed(1234)
t_for <- system.time(replicate(R,
  foreach(x = irnorm(3, count = 5), .combine = c) %do% max(x)
))["elapsed"]

# with parLapply
# distribute the 3 computations across cores
cl <- makeCluster(detectCores() - 1)
clusterSetRNGStream(cl, 1234)
t_par <- system.time(replicate(R,
  unlist(parLapply(cl, 1:3, function(i) max(rnorm(5))))
))["elapsed"]
stopCluster(cl)

c(replicate = t_rep, foreach = t_for, parLapply = t_par) # answers

replicate.elapsed   foreach.elapsed parLapply.elapsed 
            0.359            24.149            15.345
